about.title: About Instabart
about.what.title: What is Instabart?
about.what.description1: Instabart is a handy starting point for students in Trondheim — the city of moustaches.
about.what.description2: Here you'll find direct links to NTNU services. Some you'll use every day; others come in handy now and then. We recommend trying them all.
about.who.title: Who's behind the 'stache?
about.who.bio: . Morten is a former NTNU student, a fan of terrible puns, and completely unable to grow a proper moustache... ironically enough.
